title: EU AI Act Article 6 and Annex III — High-risk AI system classification
description: The classification test determining which AI systems are 'high-risk' under the EU AI Act. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: An AI system is classified as 'high-risk' either as a safety component of a product regulated under existing EU harmonisation law, or because it falls into one of the use-case categories listed in Annex III — including employment/worker management, access to essential private and public services (e.g. benefits eligibility, credit scoring), law enforcement, migration, and education — unless it does not pose a significant risk or materially influence the decision outcome.

citations.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
citations.publisher: EUR-Lex / Official Journal of the European Union

relationships.reason: The classification determination is documented as part of the data protection impact assessment.
